items.source:
Match the provided in parameter values with registered parameters and
parameters defined via meta-data processing.
items.translation: 将提供的输入参数值与已注册参数及通过元数据处理定义的参数进行匹配。

items.source: a Map of out parameters
items.translation: 一个输出参数的 Map

items.translation: 一个包含参数名称和值的 Map

items.source: Only parameters declared as SqlParameter and SqlInOutParameter will be used to provide input values. This is different from the StoredProcedure class which - for backwards compatibility reasons - allows input values to be provided for parameters declared as SqlOutParameter.
items.translation: 仅声明为SqlParameter和SqlInOutParameter的参数将用于提供输入值。这与StoredProcedure类不同，出于向后兼容的原因，该类的参数允许为声明为SqlOutParameter的参数提供输入值。

items.source: This class provides the processing arrangement for SimpleJdbcCall.
items.translation: 该类为 `SimpleJdbcCall` 提供处理安排。

items.source: Automatically called by all doExecute(...) methods.
items.translation: 由所有doExecute(...)方法自动调用。

items.source:
This finalizes the configuration for this object and subsequent attempts to compile are
ignored. This will be implicitly called the first time an un-compiled call is executed.
items.translation: 这将完成此对象的配置，随后进行的编译尝试将被忽略。当首次执行未编译的调用时，此方法将隐式被调用。

items.source:
Subclasses can override this template method to perform their own compilation.
Invoked after this base class's compilation is complete.
items.translation:
子类可以重写此模板方法以执行自己的编译。
在本基类的编译完成后调用。

items.source:
Get the name of a single out parameter or return value.
Used for functions or procedures with one out parameter.
items.translation:
获取单个输出参数或返回值的名称。
用于具有一个输出参数的函数或过程。

items.source:
Get a List of all the call parameters to be used for call.
This includes any parameters added based on meta-data processing.
items.translation:
获取用于调用的所有调用参数列表。
这包括基于元数据处理添加的任何参数。
